Use a strong focal subject, crisp subject separation, rich but controlled colour, atmospheric depth, premium lighting, and clear visual storytelling. Sell the emotional fantasy of doing the hobby rather than merely depicting an object. Aim for the feel of a miniature lifestyle hero illustration inside one coherent collectible-art universe, not a poster, advertisement, editorial cover, card face, or designed page.
